entry.title: Junior Fellows of the Simons Society of Fellows
entry.content:
Junior Fellows of the Simons Society of Fellows

Junior Fellows are outstanding young scientists who receive support from the foundation for up to 3 years to conduct independent research at an NYC educational institution. The foundation requires Junior Fellows to attend weekly lectures and dinners at the foundation during the academic year, as well as an annual conference and a 4-day weekend retreat.
Program Area: Simons Society of Fellows | Mathematics & Physical Sciences
Career Stage - Postdoc/Early Career

Each Simons Symposia series brings together mathematicians, theoretical physicists and/or theoretical computer scientists to interact and collaborate in a series of up to three symposia, held every second year and focusing on one topic or a tightly connected group of topics.

entry.title: Simons Centers of Excellence at Historically Black Colleges and Universities
entry.content:
Simons Centers of Excellence at Historically Black Colleges and Universities

The Simons HBCU Centers of Excellence program will support up to two Centers of Excellence (“CoEs”) at HBCU institutions in mathematics, physics and ecology & evolutionary biology. The program aims to foster research excellence and collaboration, and to provide pathways for students to successfully enroll in graduate STEM programs.
